newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani vegoil rates seen steady next week.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani vegoil rates seen steady next week.

text.p: Pakistani vegetable oil rates are seen steady in the next trading week on a good supply of cottonseed from the Punjab province, dealers said on Saturday.

"The vegoil prices will hold steady as the cottonseed supply is good," dealer Amir Chattha said. "But the majority of dealers are in a wait-and-see mood as they expect the caretaker government to give some concessions for the vegoil importors."
Dealers said vegoil stocks fell to 111,000 tonnes last week from 112,000 tonnes a week ago.
RBD palm oil and palm olein stocks rose to 90,000 tonnes compared to 85,000 last week. Soybean oil and sunflower oil stocks fell to 17,000 from 20,000 tonnes.
The GCP has a stock of 4,000 tonnes of palm oil and palm olien compared to 7,000 last week.

Wawasan Megah with around 25,000 tonnes of palm oil is at high seas and expected to arrive by November 12. Petr Shmdit with 10,000 soybean oil expected arrival in mid-November and Heleena with 6,000 tonnes of palm fatty acid distillates is expected on November 14.
